report_title: FleetHarbor AI - Modified Files and Code Changes Registry

files_modified.purpose: Comprehensive CSV ingestion, encoding detection, schema identification, data validation, database upsert, and ChromaDB vector indexing engine.

changes: Added init_operational_table() creating operational_records in SQLite and Supabase.
Added fetch_operational_record(doc_id) and get_operational_record(doc_id).
Added upsert_operational_records(), upsert_shipment_records(), upsert_employee_records() with idempotent conflict resolution.
Exposed get_operational_record_by_id(doc_id).
Exposed batch upsert methods (upsert_operational_records, upsert_shipment_records, upsert_employee_records).
Added .csv to SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS ('.txt', '.pdf', '.docx', '.csv').
Enriched DocUploadData with optional fields total_records, imported, skipped, failed, category, summary.
Enriched DocUploadResponse with top-level summary attribute.
Integrated process_csv_upload() for .csv files.
Generates structured CSV IMPORT SUMMARY and detailed JSON response.
Preserves existing .txt, .pdf, .docx chunking pipeline.
Updated file input element to accept .txt,.pdf,.docx,.csv.
Removed blocking required attribute from user text input when attachments exist.
Enhanced handleSend(e) to asynchronously upload attached files to /upload-doc and display the CSV IMPORT SUMMARY in dialogue.
Handles single-click file attachment and send.
Added normalize_logistics_query() correcting typos ('staus', 'stauts', 'delivry', etc.) while preserving IDs.
Added extract_operational_id() matching OPS-* across casing and spacing.
Added LogisticsIntent.OPERATIONAL_STATUS = 'operational_status'.
Added operational_id field to ClassifiedIntent dataclass.
Added build_operational_status_report() generating structured OPERATIONAL RECORD markdown card matching Issue 5.
Added Section 4c in generate_response() for deterministic operational record database lookup.
Graceful not-found messaging when operational case does not exist.

files_modified.purpose: 26 automated unit and integration tests verifying CSV ingestion, validation, query normalization, and intelligent routing.
